name: Executable foundation, contracts and test harness
scope: Freeze v0.1 runtime contracts from the specification.
Create installable Python package and `docengine` entry point.
Implement project/root discovery skeleton and stable command/JSON envelope skeleton.
Create unit/integration/E2E test harness and sample-project fixture wiring.
Introduce version constants for engine, persisted-state schema and machine-output schema.
out_of_scope: Managed resource loading semantics beyond discovery stubs.
deliverables: pyproject/package metadata and console entry point

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Package installs/imports and `docengine --help` executes from a clean environment.
Every command can use one versioned JSON result envelope even before command-specific payloads exist.
Project/root discovery never writes outside configured project/documentation roots.
Core package imports contain no project-domain terminology or research-specific assumptions.
Specification registries/schemas parse and contract tests fail on malformed fixtures.
README/START_HERE accurately identify implementation status and next phase.

emergent_questions.question: Как проверять clean-environment installation offline, если новый Python venv не содержит setuptools/build backend?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: P0-A1 требует реальную clean-environment проверку, но source install через PEP 517 требует build tooling, которое не является runtime dependency.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Build the wheel in the development/build environment and install the prebuilt wheel into a clean venv with --no-deps.
emergent_questions.answer: Clean-environment acceptance installs the prebuilt wheel; source/editable install remains a development workflow that requires build tooling.
emergent_questions.decision: Canonical distribution verification uses a prebuilt wheel. The runtime remains dependency-free in P0; build tooling is not made a runtime dependency.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Clarifies P0-A1 without expanding runtime dependencies.

emergent_questions.question: Что означает PASS по DAX-оси внутри раннего phase: глобальное закрытие оси или только проверка применимого phase risk slice?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Глобальные определения DAX03/DAX13/DAX20 шире P0; без явной семантики ранний phase мог ошибочно выглядеть как закрывший ось целиком.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Phase-local PASS означает только закрытие применимой части риска; глобальное закрытие release-gate axis выполняется в P8.
emergent_questions.answer: Использовать phase-local PASS и отдельно считать global progress; P8 выполняет consolidated global review.
emergent_questions.decision: Уточнить acceptance model и human docs; P0 axis statuses остаются PASS только в phase scope.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Предотвращает ложное утверждение, что stub-команды уже глобально закрыли DAX13/DAX12 и другие оси.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли manifest/spec audit считать transient Python/pytest artifacts частью canonical package?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Обычный запуск тестов создаёт `.pytest_cache` и `__pycache__`; старый audit после этого ложно сообщал manifest mismatch.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Нет; manifest сравнивает canonical files и игнорирует строго перечисленные transient test/runtime artifacts.
emergent_questions.answer: Игнорировать `.pytest_cache`, `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`, `*.pyo`, `.coverage` и `*.egg-info` при manifest file-set check.
emergent_questions.decision: Исправить `tools/audit_spec.py` и добавить regression test, который запускает audit при наличии transient artifacts.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: DAX20 может считаться phase-scope PASS только после воспроизводимого tests→audit workflow.

implementation_log.entry: Implemented installable pyproject package and console entry point.
Implemented version constants and stable JSON command envelope.
Implemented read-only root discovery and path confinement foundation.
Built wheel and installed it into a clean virtual environment.
Clarified phase-local versus global DAX axis semantics after post-acceptance review.
Fixed spec/manifest audit to ignore explicitly transient Python/pytest artifacts and added regression coverage.

acceptance_summary.notes: P0 accepted and post-acceptance axis-audited. All P0 criteria remain pass. DAX statuses are phase-scope passes, not global axis closure. A reproducibility defect in manifest audit after test-cache creation was found and fixed; regression coverage added. P1 remains next.
